verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document per-agent spend caps, usage limits, or instant revocation of an agent's payment authority. Agentic accounts and wallets only give an agent a funding source. The 'upto' scheme's maximum authorization and batch settlement's signed escrow limits and withdrawal semantics are per-payment or per-session mechanics, which are adjacent features rather than user-set agent governance controls. Capping exposure by limiting how much is loaded into an agent wallet would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.
